speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn with a generalized rash. To help you, could you tell me exactly what the rash looks like and when it first appeared?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Conjunctivitis (Ophthalmia Neonatorum) with secondary disseminated rash.

This diagnosis is based on the mother's history of untreated gonorrhea and the 4-day-old age of the infant. I request a Gram stain and culture of any ocular discharge, and a blood culture to confirm systemic involvement.
